title: MongoDB IPO: Nasdaq Debut Campaign
summary: Out-of-home and press creative marking MongoDB's October 2017 Nasdaq debut, including Times Square placements and national print.
overview: Creative for MongoDB's public listing on Nasdaq (ticker MDB) in October 2017 -- a wrap and digital placements on the Nasdaq MarketSite tower and surrounding Times Square screens, plus a national print ad, all built around the line "Finally, after 40 years, a real alternative" -- a direct nod to the fact that the relational database was introduced more than 40 years earlier.

blocks.title: Out-of-home and press, as placed
blocks.overview: Photographed in Times Square around MongoDB's Nasdaq listing, plus the matching national print ad.

Closer view of the Nasdaq MarketSite tower fully wrapped in the green-and-white mongoDB "Finally, after 40 years, a real alternative / NasdaqListed MDB" creative, with an EY ad visible to the left
A large green Times Square digital billboard reading "mongoDB, NasdaqListed MDB" beneath an "Out Now" marquee, with a yellow cab and NYPD car passing below

Dusk view of the Nasdaq tower showing a tall vertical mongoDB wordmark banner alongside a digital panel reading "Finally, after 40 years, a real alternative / mongoDB / NasdaqListed MDB," with mongoDB leaf-mark panels lit on nearby buildings and a "Welcome to Times Square" sign visible

blocks.alt: A national print ad for MongoDB's Nasdaq listing, headlined "Finally, after 40 years, a real alternative," with the mongoDB leaf mark and a Nasdaq "MDB" listing notice, photographed beside a rotary phone

blocks.title: Concept exploration

images.caption: Concept exploration, nighttime mockup of the same creative -- not a placed billboard.
